title: Remove 🥺 emoji from all text everywhere in the app

requirements.text: Remove every instance of the 🥺 emoji from all text in the frontend, including but not limited to: the main page message in App.tsx (MainCard), the 'You are my Patronus, Saachi' line, the Yes button label, the CelebrationScreen messages, and any quips or strings in RunawayButton. No 🥺 emoji should appear anywhere in the rendered UI.
acceptanceCriteria: The 🥺 emoji does not appear anywhere in the main page message (MainCard / App.tsx).
The 'You are my Patronus, Saachi' line no longer contains the 🥺 emoji.
The Yes button label contains no 🥺 emoji.
All messages and lines on the CelebrationScreen contain no 🥺 emoji.
All quips in RunawayButton contain no 🥺 emoji.
No other component or string literal in the frontend contains the 🥺 emoji.
All other text, styling, and functionality remains unchanged.

constraints: Only remove the 🥺 emoji; do not alter any other text, styling, or logic.
Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/ or frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Changing any wording, phrasing, or messaging beyond removing the 🥺 emoji.
Removing any other emojis (e.g. ✨, ⚡, 🐍) that are part of the Harry Potter / Slytherin theme.
